summary: Copyright line at the bottom of every screen
author: pm
body:
The user, 2026-11-25: "And on every screen at the bottom we want to put a copyright messages: "Copyright (C) 2004 Siemantech Co., Ltd"". They would also like a second line crediting their own recreation work ("this is open sourced so I am not worried about someone stealing it").

Open questions for the user:
- the exact company spelling: 3.82's registry key reads "Siementech" (game382.cpp line 51), not "Siemantech";
- the wording of the recreation line;
- which screens count as "every screen": front-end only, or in game too.

Nothing in sources/client draws a copyright line today (grep "copyright", 2026-11-25).

**Done when:** the agreed line(s) show bottom-centre on every agreed screen at 4:3 and 16:9, in one shared helper so each screen calls it once.

**User answers, 2026-11-25:**
- Screens: front end only (splash, loading, main menu, login, create account, character select, character create, quit). Not in game.
- Line 1: "Copyright (C) 2004 Siementech Co., Ltd" (the 3.82 spelling).
- Line 2: "Recreation (C) 2026 The Heldenian Project - open source".
